title: Non-uniform Continuity for the MHD equations with only Magnetic Diffusion
summary: In this paper, we prove the non-uniform continuity of the data-to-solution map for the incompressible magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) equations with only magnetic diffusion in Sobolev spaces $H^s(\mathbb{R}^d)$ for all $s>0$ and $d=2,3$. Our results are first studies on the non-uniform continuity of the data-to-solution map for the resistive MHD equations.
